title: Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum — Hangar 37

orientationControl.basis: Named Hangar 37 map feature, inspected local Qualla aerial, museum front photograph taken from the control tower and architect frontage.

terrainContact.basis: Apron immediately outside the entrance frontage.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap and independently inspected Qualla/museum/architect photographs.
axis: +X northwest, +Z northeast toward control tower, +Y up.
identityStatus: Hangar 37 only, with museum entrance canopy. Control tower and Hangar 79 are separate assets.
notes: Mapped rectangle approximately 68.7 by 47.7 m. Entrance faces northeast toward the control tower. Two broad shallow roof gables, corrugated sliding door fronts, checker canopy and ridge ventilation follow dated photographs. Architect project floor area 42,442 sq ft is not assumed to equal the generalized footprint.
limitations: Generalized footprint is not an architectural survey.
Roof heights, unseen rear openings and side cladding are conservative estimates; no interior or aircraft modeled.
Dated 2008–2017 references do not establish all present-day signage or later renovations.
